cards.title: Whole division with //
cards.body: `/` gives a decimal: `7 / 2` is `3.5`. `//` keeps only the whole part: `7 // 2` is `3`.

cards.title: The remainder with %
cards.body: `%` gives what is left over after whole division. 7 split into groups of 2 leaves 1 over.

cards.title: Printing several values
cards.body: Give `print()` several values separated by commas and it puts one space between each.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: 100 // 60 is 1 whole hour, and 100 % 60 is the 40 minutes left over.

exercise.prompt: Read a number of minutes and print it as `H h M min`. Use `//` for the whole hours and `%` for the minutes left over. For `135`, print `2 h 15 min`
